*Sanidassanattika, Sahetukaduka* (Patthana 16.47) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Canon. Methodologically situated within the combinatory scheme of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text coordinates the *sanidassana* triad (the triad concerning visible or visual phenomena) with the *sahetuka* dyad (the dyad concerning phenomena associated with root conditions).

No historical external parallels in non-Pali traditions or Chinese Āgama collections are recorded for this text [DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma corpus, registering 136 matching passages across 50 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its closest textual parallels occur within related combinatorial sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably including other *sanidassana* subsections such as *Sanidassanattika, Sappaṭighaduka* (Patthana 16.54), *Sanidassanattika, Ajjhattaduka* (Patthana 16.74), *Sanidassanattika, Sappītikaduka* (Patthana 16.84), *Sanidassanattika, Sāsavaduka* (Patthana 16.59), and *Sanidassanattika, Hetusampayuttaduka* (Patthana 16.48) [DharmaNexus]. Additionally, it shares recurring formulas with *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1) and aligns directly with another section bearing the identical title, *Sanidassanattika, Sahetukaduka* (Patthana 22.27) [DharmaNexus].
